verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that alerts raised during ongoing monitoring can be reviewed in case management, and that a case audit trail endpoint exists. Neither documents a way to see what changed in a monitored customer's screening profile or matches that triggered the new alert. The case audit log covers the case's own history, which is an adjacent feature rather than a view of what changed on the customer.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can inspect what changed when a monitored customer produces a new alert
